turns.speaker: A
turns.en: Steep mountain staircases keep Ridgeside calves healthy... though tricky in winter ice!
turns.es: Escaleras empinadas fortalecen piernas... aunque en hielo invernal piden cuidado!

turns.speaker: B
turns.en: Between clinic downstairs and mountain calls uphill, Pelican Valley stays thoroughly cared for!
turns.es: Entre clinica abajo y rondas arriba, todo el valle queda bien atendido!

turns.speaker: A
turns.en: Learned half my cleanest dovetail cuts watching your mountain mill, Robin!
turns.es: Aprendi la mitad de mis ensambles viendo tu taller, Robin!

turns.speaker: B
turns.en: And you never cut corners fixing neighbor fences, Ian! Solid craftsmanship runs both ways!
turns.es: Y tu nunca escatimas arreglando cercas vecinas, Ian! Excelente oficio!

turns.speaker: A
turns.en: Extra smoky ginger glaze makes tonight's mountain roast shine bright, Anton!
turns.es: Glaseado ahumado de jengibre hace brillar el asado hoy, Anton!

turns.speaker: B
turns.en: Balanced salt beats overpowering sauces every evening—let guests decide cleanly!
turns.es: Sal equilibrada vence salsas pesadas cada noche... que decida la mesa!

turns.speaker: A
turns.en: Try softening the bridge cadence gently in F-major next concert, Alissa!
turns.es: Prueba suavizar el puente en Fa mayor en el proximo recital, Alissa!

turns.speaker: B
turns.en: Ooh, crystal light shimmer right on that third note! Perfect acoustic match!
turns.es: Ooh, brillo limpio justo en esa tercera nota! Armonia perfecta!

turns.speaker: A
turns.en: Bet three pinecones my mud puddle splash cleared six feet today!
turns.es: Apuesto tres pinas a que mi salto de charco cruzo dos metros hoy!

turns.speaker: B
turns.en: Ew! Keep splash mud completely away from my lavender bow, Keahi!!
turns.es: Guacala! Manten ese barro lejos de mi moño lavanda, Keahi!!

turns.speaker: A
turns.en: Ridgeside herbal poultices blend cleanly with Harvey's clinic salves!
turns.es: Emplastos de Ridgeside combinan genial con unguentos de Harvey!

turns.speaker: B
turns.en: Good neighbors share healing knowledge freely uphill and down!
turns.es: Buenos vecinos comparten remedios sin reservas arriba y abajo del monte!

turns.speaker: A
turns.en: Thunder echoes loud down Ridgeside waterfall gorges tonight!
turns.es: Truenos resuenan fuerte por gargantas de cascadas hoy!

turns.speaker: B
turns.en: Stay safely sheltered inside warm cedar walls till gusts pass!
turns.es: Resguardate bajo techos calidos hasta que pase el temporal!
